julia_sales: Heads-up — HorizonCare (large regional payer) asked for a 2-week presales POC. Requirements: SAML SSO (Okta + Azure), SCIM provisioning for ~85k users, delegated admin across 4 subdomains, RBAC mapping to 9 roles, support for customer KMS in a VPC connector, and option for air-gapped on-prem connector. They also sent a security questionnaire. Can SE confirm any blockers and a rough POC estimate?
sam_se: Generally doable. Immediate clarifications: 1) Do they want SCIM over mTLS (Private-only) or token auth (hosted possible)? 2) Change rate — do they expect >2k deltas/day? 3) Domain verification method for delegated admin (DNS TXT preferred).
julia_sales: I'll ask them. They said ~2.2k changes/day, and prefer mTLS for provisioning.
natalie_infosec: Note on compliance: HIPAA in scope — BAA required before PHI ingestion. For KMS: we support BYOK in Private; keys remain in customer KMS and we use envelope encryption. Draft answer for questionnaire: "Customer-managed KMS is supported in Private deployments. Keys are stored in customer KMS; Redwood only stores envelope-wrapped keys and does not have access to raw key material." Add that?
sam_se: Good. Technical notes: with ~85k users and 2.2k/day deltas, recommend Private with SCIM mTLS or Dedicated with SCIM bulk + delta. If they insist on hosted with token SCIM, rate limits may be hit during initial sync. For delegated admin mapping we need a CSV mapping table and conflict resolution policy (source-of-truth = IdP).
ryan_soleng: POC config checklist I'll need from customer:
- SAML metadata (IdP cert, entityID, ACS, SingleLogout)
- SCIM service account + mTLS client cert (if Private)
- RBAC mapping CSV (group_external_id,group_name,assigned_role)
- Domain verification method (DNS TXT records or signed assertion)
- Network allowlist + proxy details for connector
- KMS details + indication of BYOK or Redwood-managed
Example RBAC CSV header: group_external_id,group_name,role
Example CSV row: billing-admins,Billing Admins,billing_admin
ryan_soleng: Example SCIM PATCH to set roles:
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "Replace",
    "path": "urn:custom:roles",
    "value": ["claims_reviewer","billing_admin"]
  }]
}
sam_se: SAML cert rotation: we support overlapping cert windows. Process: upload new cert, set activation timestamp; old cert remains valid until overlap end to ensure zero-downtime. We'll document exact steps in the questionnaire response.
natalie_infosec: Also call out telemetry limits in air-gapped setups: some advanced tracing and live sampling are disabled when there's no outbound telemetry. We'll note that as a caveat.
julia_sales: Cost ask for 2-week POC (Private connector + installer + SE support). Ballpark?
ryan_soleng: Ballpark: Private staging & connector work $14k (prorated), installer & runbook $6k, SE support & runbooks $5k -> total ~$25k. If they require air-gapped on-prem inference nodes add ~$38k. Final quote after finance sign-off.
infra-bot: ticket RED-41234 created for HorizonCare POC (owner: sam_se) - https://redwood.atlassian.example/RED-41234
julia_sales: Thanks. I'll request the SAML metadata, mTLS cert, and a sample RBAC CSV from the customer and loop legal for BAA. Will paste their replies here. :thumbsup:
